title: 16:42. O celular vibrou.
concept: Suspense on a wooden table under blind light: a phone buzzes at 16:42 with a blurred KizuBot alarm, a 3-2-1 countdown and a hard 0.4 s silence, then the real customer print reveals shiny Cubone detected and caught in the same minute.
claims: detecção de shinys, megas e bosses
alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp

notes: Music: one kzaudio style per track, so the concept's 'tension (96) then phonk drop' is a phonk track at 96 BPM with a muffled intro, heartbeat/clock SFX, a build, a 0.4 s stop and the drop on the reveal. The phone, lock screen and 'KizuBot™ | kizubot.com' notification are a generic illustrated mock with the message blurred; the real alarm is only shown via the customer print. Pre-reveal 'silence' is a near-black purple hush (pure black failed QC's black-segment check). Added captions '16:42 · shiny detectado' / '16:42 · capturado' and the quote 'cantou big' set verbatim with its print on screen ('a reação, 10 min depois' = 16:42 → 16:52 in the print). Final line uses the NEURO slogan 'Shiny apareceu? O zap avisou.'
